scope: Refresh selected preset: direct read-only browser-rendered observations plus attributed third-party automated scan; no VSN interaction or accessibility tests.

claims.observed: Rendered pages expose category stories, product information accordions, a hair-routine cross-link, journal cards and an empty-cart favorites shelf.
claims.risk: Rendered DOM presence does not prove working links/controls or that recommendations reflect selected variants.
claims.vsn_guard: Build reusable merchant-configured category, disclosure, blog and routine sections; verify interaction and selected-variant context before release.

claims.observed: Demo content claims vegan/cruelty-free status, certifications, clinical testing, recyclable packaging, US origin, review volume, a free return guarantee and free-shipping threshold.
claims.risk: Demo copy is not independent evidence of real products, certification, jurisdiction, current shipping rules or legal compliance.
claims.vsn_guard: Display claims only when the merchant supplies current evidence and market scope; do not ship example promises as default theme copy.

claims.observed: AccessifyAI reports 5 issue types and 9 occurrences on version 16.0.0 dated 2026-09-29; the official listing accessed on 2026-10-26 shows version 16.1.0 released 2026-10-09.
claims.risk: The external scan predates the listed theme version and its automated coverage is limited; it cannot establish present accessibility status.
claims.vsn_guard: Use the report only as a prompt for independent manual checks on the actual target version and content.
